title: Business Central Under the Hood episode 5: How To Make Your AL Code Super Fast

chapters.title: Measuring code execution speed and database impact

Flow fields and set load fields optimization

Page search and full table scans

Parallel execution, concurrent operations, and diagnostics tools

features.name: Performance Toolkit
features.description: A tool that helps measure and compare database calls between code versions. It shows both timings and the number of SQL statements, accessible to partners for free.

features.name: Telemetry monitoring for long-running queries
features.description: Microsoft uses telemetry to detect queries longer than 750 milliseconds across customers and log them for analysis. Partners can use Application Insights to monitor their own customers.
caveats: 750 millisecond threshold for logging

features.name: Flow fields
features.description: An optimization technique to let SQL perform calculations and aggregations instead of AL code. Can sum underlying entries or provide lookups like customer names without fetching entire records.

features.name: Set load fields function
features.description: Function to specify only needed fields when retrieving records, avoiding loading entire records with extensions. For example, loading only a currency code instead of the full customer record.

features.name: AL to SQL code generation
features.description: AL statements are transformed into SQL queries at runtime. The NST checks its cache first before issuing SQL statements, providing in-memory operation when data is cached.

features.name: Session caching strategy
features.description: Data cached at the company session level is shared across all users logging into that company. First users on Monday morning experience slower initial loads as they hydrate the cache for everyone.
caveats: affects early morning users

features.name: Index seek optimization
features.description: Using indexes to efficiently locate records. When a field is indexed and at the beginning of the index, SQL can perform an exact seek rather than scanning the entire index.

features.name: Read isolation feature
features.description: Allows developers to read records without locking, only reading committed or uncommitted data as specified, even when called from within a locking scope.
caveats: may not be a game changer but helps with concurrency
requires developer uptake and partner adoption
Not considered a game changer but improves system concurrency

features.name: Database locks page
features.description: Shows who is currently holding locks in the system and what is being locked.
caveats: only useful when locks are actively held
partner may not have access to customer systems
Requires access to the system
Only useful when locks are actively occurring
Locks disappear after they release

features.name: Missing indexes page
features.description: Shows SQL suggestions for missing indexes that could improve performance.

features.name: In-client profiler
features.description: Allows users to record an action and get a profile showing where time is spent. Can download profile file and open in Visual Studio Code.

features.name: Application Insights
features.description: Analytics tool for diagnosing performance issues and customer cases and for monitoring long-running queries and lock behavior.

features.name: Cross-System Index Recommendations Dashboard
features.description: Microsoft collects index recommendation data from all SQL servers across all customer systems and combines it into a dashboard showing which indexes are missing most frequently.
caveats: Optimizes for average or 80% of usage patterns

features.name: Number Sequences for Entry Number Generation
features.description: Replaces table locking patterns with non-locking number sequence generation for entry numbers, allowing concurrent transaction posting.
caveats: First step only
May not be suitable for GL due to country legislations
Entry order may not be sequential

features.name: Concurrent Warehouse Entry Posting
features.description: BC25 October release includes implementation allowing separate concurrent posting to warehouse entries, enabling warehouse workers to perform operations while office staff work simultaneously.
caveats: First step toward fully concurrent sales order posting
Open source implementation available

features.name: SQL Full Text Indexing for Page Search
features.description: Planned improvement using SQL Server full text indexing to make searching in customer lists, item lists, and dropdown selection very fast.
caveats: Short-term initiative
Expected in BC25

features.name: Concurrency and Parallelization for Bulk Operations
features.description: Long-term initiative to enable parallel processing of large posting operations like posting 50,000 sales orders or creating 50,000 items using multiple threads.
caveats: Long-term roadmap item
Warehouse improvements are first step
